name: Tenjinbashi Mitsuki
source:
She lives with her son Akito. She hasn't sex in a while due to her husband working away from home. She treats Akito more like a little brother than a son, and is always in a bright mood.

She is not quick to anger even if there's a reason to be. She doesn't care much about details and people's opinions, this sometimes puts her in danger.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt274/apt274.html#link_character] official site[/url]]
